en.message: Optional analytics cookies are used only with consent. Choose Accept or Reject.

bg.message: Незадължителните аналитични бисквитки се използват само със съгласие. Изберете Приемам или Отказвам.

critical_html_js_distinction.source_based_conclusion: The close icon's HTML attribute is misleading, but the installed click handler explicitly rejects. Do NOT report the X icon as an accidental acceptance bug without browser-level contrary evidence.

other_handlers.revoke: opens selection banner; a subsequent Reject selection sets cookie_notice_accepted=false

implications: Built-in classic Cookie Notice can render EN/BG Accept, Reject and Change-choice elements without replacing plugin.
Need real browser keyboard/mobile and preference-state QA, including whether manual revoke interaction is sufficiently accessible.
Built-in UI controls alone do not block legacy GA scripts: Cookie Compliance autoblocking inactive in current classic mode.
HTML data-cookie-set on close does not govern close action; actual JavaScript listener takes precedence.
Modeled event lifecycles are not a HAR/cookie capture and cannot prove GDPR compliance.
